# Send the money back to Robert for the latest approved accidental payment request
venmo_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='ta.weav@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

robert_email = 'robertmartinez@gmail.com'
refund_amount = 74.0

tx_resp = apis.venmo.create_transaction(
    receiver_email=robert_email,
    amount=refund_amount,
    access_token=venmo_token,
    description='Refund for accidental payment request'
)
print(tx_resp)

transaction_id = tx_resp.get('transaction_id')
print('transaction_id', transaction_id)
if transaction_id is not None:
    tx = apis.venmo.show_transaction(transaction_id=transaction_id, access_token=venmo_token)
    print(tx)

print('new venmo_balance:', apis.venmo.show_venmo_balance(access_token=venmo_token))

# Verify refund transaction matches the accidental request: latest approved sent request to Robert
venmo_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='ta.weav@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']
robert_email='robertmartinez@gmail.com'

# latest approved sent payment request id and amount
all_reqs=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, query=robert_email, status='approved', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    print('page', page_index, 'len', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    all_reqs.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

from datetime import datetime

def parse_dt(s):
    return datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace('Z','+00:00'))

exact=[r for r in all_reqs if (r.get('receiver') or {}).get('email')==robert_email]
exact_sorted=sorted(exact, key=lambda r: parse_dt(r['created_at']), reverse=True)
latest=exact_sorted[0]
print('latest approved request id', latest['payment_request_id'], 'amount', latest['amount'], 'created_at', latest['created_at'])

# show refund transaction that we just created
refund_tx_id=8217
refund_tx=apis.venmo.show_transaction(transaction_id=refund_tx_id, access_token=venmo_token)
print('refund tx id', refund_tx_id)
print('refund amount', refund_tx['amount'])
print('refund receiver email', refund_tx['receiver']['email'])
print('refund sender email', refund_tx['sender']['email'])

print('match_amount', refund_tx['amount']==latest['amount'])
print('match_receiver', refund_tx['receiver']['email']==robert_email)
